title: Block first layer
statement: For $m\ge 7$, the first layer is the list of DNF terms obtained by ranging over all pairs of a block index below $m$ and a sign assignment on $2m$ positions, and taking the block minterm associated with each pair. The list has $m2^{2m}$ entries.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the block minterm, so its literals cannot be specified further.
